Article: From Reusable to Regeneratable: Rethinking the Shared UI Component Library
items.blurb: Regeneration has changed reuse economics. A model pointed at a solid design system can produce most standard UI on demand, so paying to keep a canonical component package alive is much harder to justify than it used to be.
